input.contract_name: Garrison Food Service (Full Food Service and Management and Mess Attendant Services)
input.notes: Two installations: MCB Camp Halloran (Mainside, Tarrant Creek, Oyster Bay, Camp Whitlock, Camp Dunning, Shell Point Range Complex) and MCAS Pell River, North Carolina. Phase-in 1-30 Sep 2027 (30 days, not separately priced); base 1 Oct 2027-30 Sep 2028 (12 months) plus four 12-month option periods through 30 Sep 2032; possible extension up to 6 months under FAR 52.217-8 (not an option period). Subsistence is Government-furnished (DLA prime vendor), not in the contract price. Grounds maintenance is performed by the Government (TE-5 5.2, Q&A A8). Climate not stated; inferred from North Carolina.

input.notes: Part 3.2 and Q&A A6: 12-month base plus four 12-month options, 1 Oct 2022 - 30 Sep 2027. Total value $298,746,215 includes all options as modified through P00011 (P00011 deleted Bldg TC-410 line items effective 5 Jan 2026 and increased TC-575). Option Period 4 (1 Oct 2026 - 30 Sep 2027, current period) = $63,215,480 (used as annual value). Total invoiced 1 Oct 2022 - 30 Sep 2026 (48 months) = $233,418,605 (A6). Not included: FAR 52.217-8 extension estimate $31,607,740 (6 months); banquet/special-event BPA M67443-24-A-0007 (ceiling $3,500,000); Government-furnished subsistence (FY2026 obligations approx. $38.9 million).

input.summary: Garrison food service, MCB Camp Halloran and MCAS Pell River, NC (M67443-27-R-0019). TE-1 (20 rows) registered with Gross SF, Sanitation Area SF, dining room SF, seats and days of operation; TE-3 (19 rows) per-meal-period weekday and weekend/holiday headcounts; TE-3A projected headcount for optional Bldg D-1720 (option_only). TC-410 is closed for renovation (vacant, no workload). Amendment 0001 applied: D-512 deleted, D-450 headcount revised (2,620 M-F / 2,455 weekend), Bldg 227 corrected to 46,920 gross / 41,380 sanitation SF. In scope after the amendment: 15 mess halls and 2 satellites. Grounds maintenance is performed by the Government (TE-5 5.2, A8), so no grounds were registered. Incumbent: Longleaf Garrison Dining, LLC, FFP M67443-22-C-0004, $298,746,215 total value, Option Period 4 $63,215,480, $233,418,605 invoiced over 48 months.
unresolved: TE-1 printed total gross 453,095 SF is the table as issued; Amendment 0001 Item 5 revises it to 452,615 SF (17 facilities) after deleting D-512 (-23,940) and correcting Bldg 227 (+23,460). TE-3 total is revised to 21,615 M-F / 9,655 weekend / 126,930 weekly.

M&MA mess halls (260, TC-303, D-615, AS-505) were recorded as dining_facility_attendant: Marines cook, the contractor provides management, mess attendants, cashiers and all sanitation; no service style exactly matches management plus mess attendant.

Satellites SP-24 and AS-219 were recorded as full_food_service because their meals are prepared by the contractor at the parent FFS mess halls (D-301, AS-4150) and their headcount is not in the parent's TE-3 figures.
Kitchen SF is not printed; TE-2 serving hours and TE-4 historical meals (information only) were not registered as workload tables.
